status: Automated DOM-key browser gameplay; individual assertions and completion states govern scope
scope: Movement and coarse keyboard look use synthetic standard DOM keyboard events and real browser timers/RAFs. Fine mouse aim/clicks, press and explicitly trusted-key commands use Playwright UI input. Actual game physics/render/audio/save; read-only public snapshots. No save/body/win/machine/clock injection. This is not an all-trusted-input run.
